mapper.insert: INSERT INTO album (group_id, user_id, name, description) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.name, a.description, a.created_at, a.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo_album pa WHERE pa.album_id = a.id) AS photo_count, (SELECT p.storage_path FROM photo_album pa JOIN photo p ON pa.photo_id = p.id WHERE pa.album_id = a.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cover_photo_url FROM album a WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT storage_path FROM photo WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT storage_path FROM photo WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id, a.group_id, a.name, a.description, a.created_at, a.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo_album pa WHERE pa.album_id = a.id) AS photo_count, (SELECT p.storage_path FROM photo_album pa JOIN photo p ON pa.photo_id = p.id WHERE pa.album_id = a.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cover_photo_url FROM album a WHERE (a.group_id = #{groupId}) OR (a.group_id IS NULL AND a.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.storage_path, p.taken_date, p.location_name, p.city, COALESCE(pr.provence, p.province) AS province, p.country, p.description, p.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname FROM photo_album pa JOIN photo p ON pa.photo_id = p.id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN provence pr ON pr.id = p.province WHERE pa.album_id = #{albumId} AND (p.is_deleted IS NULL OR p.is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY p.taken_date DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo_album pa JOIN photo p ON pa.photo_id = p.id WHERE pa.album_id = #{albumId} AND (p.is_deleted IS NULL OR p.is_deleted = 0)
SELECT p.id, p.storage_path FROM photo p JOIN photo_album pa ON pa.photo_id = p.id WHERE pa.album_id = #{albumId} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo_album WHERE photo_id = p.id) = 1
